chapter: Early heroes and Kid Ory band
title: Hospital aside and Buddy Christian faking reading
summary: After an aside about his x-ray, he says Buddy Christian had girls play pieces, then caught the key by ear so everyone thought he could read.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: Yeah, did they give you an x-ray down there? Where down? Hospital. Oh yeah. Yeah. But they said they didn't find nothing down there. They said it wasn't the matter with my lungs. Well, they're talking about two months to find something on me. Yeah. They laid me all kinds of ways down there. Yeah. Alright.
Let's ask you about Buddy Christian again.

You want to talk about Buddy Christian again? Oh, Buddy Christian? Yeah, we used to go around them little girls, and he used to have stock of music, and he'd make them little girls play it. And after they played, they'd make them play it again. Then he'd sit down and catch in the same key. And he couldn't read the tone, you know. But he'd catch it in the same key, and that made everybody think he could read. But people that know music know that he made the right chords, you know, when he was playing. But that's where I used to catch them too, you know. Yeah.
